name: element.create
title: Create element
summary: Create an element with a new random UUID. Only title, text and required properties are needed; empty required properties give a hint (SR-064). New elements always get the initial status of the metamodel (D-030); when their type lacks it or it is marked invalid, the first status of the type in metamodel order that is not marked invalid, and no status for a type without status or with only invalid statuses (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#306, ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#344). The file is named by the type prefix and the last 12 hex characters of the UUID (`SR-54538f4d6e55.md`); the short ID shows the last 6 or more (`SR-4d6e55`), so search the files for `4d6e55` (D-017, D-056, #639).
whileReadOnlyReason: Writes an element file, and no change can be checked against a missing or faulty metamodel.

text.description: Markdown text of the element, written below the frontmatter after one blank line; that blank line after the closing `---` is not part of the text. A final line break is added (ADR-0004). Another element is named by a Markdown link, `[Title](reqseq:N-6010df)` with its UUID, short ID or identifier, which is written as UUID and version; `reqseq:N-6010df` alone is no link and counts for nothing.

properties.description: Values of the properties of the type, by key.

relations.description: Relations of the new element by kind, written in the same file (#175), e.g. {"derives-from": ["N-073", "N-030"], "based-on": "D-062"}; on the CLI --relations derives-from='["N-073","N-030"]' --relations based-on=D-062.

repository.description: Workspace name of the repository to write the element to. Default: the main repository.

folder.description: Folder relative to the repository; default from the type.

names.description: The elements the element names by UUID only, each once in the order first named: the variants of `validity` and the views and missing children of `verification`, as element.get names them (#1216). Left out when it names none.

files.description: Written files, relative to the workspace root.
